bagPolicy.summary: Fans attending events at Allstate Arena cannot enter with backpacks, totes, mid/large sized bags, and coolers. Diaper bags with a child and medical bags are allowed after a security search.
allowed: Medical bags (approved, no bigger than 12" x 12")
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags with a child and medical bags are exceptions and allowed after a security search.

parking.note: Parking is available close to all entrances of the Allstate Arena for a fee of $25, payable by cash or credit card. Parking opens two hours prior to event start time, and tailgating is not permitted.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Allstate Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Allstate Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair seating is on the lower level behind sections 113 and 116, and behind 105 and 108 for some setups. Buy accessible tickets on Ticketmaster (choose Request Accessible Tickets, or call 800-745-3000) or at the box office. Free wheelchair escorts are available at any entry.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Allstate Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Allstate Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Allstate Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
